text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...! Haaaaaaah--!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the incident with Rhein Kraft, 
Cesario had been dedicating herself to 
training with even greater focus than 
before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The motion analysis finished, and looking 
at the numbers displayed on the screen... 
an impressively high score had been 
recorded!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With this, she can head into the Yushun 
Himba with full focus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The goal is achieving the Triple Tiara. We 
absolutely cannot afford to drop the Oaks—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was something she had spoken of 
constantly, even before I scouted her.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks is special to me. It was the 
race that had the greatest impact on me 
when I was young."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing our seniors risk it all to claim 
victory on that stage... I still admire 
them to this day."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Watching Craft take on all these new 
challenges—

text_block_list.name: Craft & Heart
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhh—!! Haaaaaaahhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent...! A truly magnificent run, 
demonstrating her immense power!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
There were so many firsts, and I felt a 
bit anxious myself... But I was able to 
run with a calm mind!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... I was able to run the race 
I wanted to... And that I was truly able 
to show my brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I realized that I can't afford to be 
careless either.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"To ensure I am not outshined by that 
radiance, I shall certainly claim victory 
today..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I wish to be as straightforward and true 
as she is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The second act of the Triple Tiara, the 
Oaks. Cesario's own enthusiasm was quite 
fierce—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if echoing the sentiment, the stands 
were abuzz with talk of Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Cesario's definitely the one to beat 
today. Her Oka Sho was insane, and she's 
overwhelmingly the first favorite in the 
pre-polls, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well, I still want to root for Messiah. 
Her mother came in 2nd, right? It'd be so 
hype if she could surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Sure, that's exciting and all, but I 
wonder. The only one the other runners are 
keeping an eye on is Cesario, after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's true~ Well, it'll be something to 
look forward to once it starts!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~... I wonder if Cesario is doing 
alright~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, the high level of attention 
wasn't limited to just the grandstands."

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
The key today is Cesario. Let's react 
based on how she moves.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll do what I can... to keep them 
from getting into a good position.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone looks up to Cesario-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"You're right... As expected of 
Cesario-san."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ... However, nothing is decided yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Please watch over me, Mother...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Are you asking whether I feel any 
pressure?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, forgive me, but that 
is a foolish question.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I have things that I must accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Do what must be done. There is not a 
single thing to fear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone dreams of that brilliance. The 
dazzling, reigning title of the Queen of 
the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Oaks begins.
